classification.difficultyReason: Audit supplied transformations, distinguish arithmetic errors from invalid treatment of terms or inverse operations, explain each defect, and solve the original equations correctly.

content.prompt: Describe the mistake made in each of these and provide the correct solution.

spec.description: Three vertically stacked equations with relation signs aligned. Paired downward curved arrows labelled divide by 4 connect the first two rows; paired arrows labelled subtract 2 connect the last two rows.
spec.mathematics: 4x+2=36; x+2=9; x=7. Preserve the intentional failure to divide the constant term by 4.
spec.answerVisibility: All erroneous equations and operation arrows remain permanently visible in the student prompt; the correction is answer content only.

inlines.text: The constant term 2 was not divided by 4.

answer.worked:
Dividing by 4 must divide every term, including 2. Undo the addition first:
$$\begin{align*}4x&=34\\x&=\frac{17}{2}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Three vertically stacked equations with relation signs aligned. Paired downward curved arrows labelled subtract 10 connect the first two rows; paired arrows labelled divide by 3 connect the last two rows.
spec.mathematics: 3x+10=43; 3x=33; x=30. Preserve the deliberately incorrect evaluation of 33 divided by 3.
spec.answerVisibility: All erroneous equations and operation arrows remain permanently visible in the student prompt; the correction is answer content only.

spec.description: Three vertically stacked equations with relation signs aligned. Paired downward curved arrows labelled subtract 5 connect the first two rows; paired arrows labelled divide by 2 connect the last two rows.
spec.mathematics: 2a+5=11; 2a=16; a=8. Preserve the deliberate arithmetic error in subtracting 5.
spec.answerVisibility: All erroneous equations and operation arrows remain permanently visible in the student prompt; the correction is answer content only.

spec.description: Three vertically stacked equations with relation signs aligned. Paired downward curved arrows labelled subtract 12 connect the first two rows; paired arrows labelled subtract 7 connect the last two rows.
spec.mathematics: 7+12a=43; 7+a=31; a=24. Preserve the deliberately incorrect inverse operation for multiplication by 12.
spec.answerVisibility: All erroneous equations and operation arrows remain permanently visible in the student prompt; the correction is answer content only.

inlines.text: Subtracting 12 does not undo multiplication by 12. Subtract 7, then divide by 12:

answer.worked:
Multiplication by 12 is undone by division by 12. First subtract 7, then divide by 12:
$$\begin{align*}12a&=36\\a&=3\end{align*}$$
